name: cpa-band
description: CPA relay quota and usage plus this session's tokens, cost, cache countdown and model, in four styles, above the prompt, in a pane, a widget or the status line

style.title: Style
style.description: classic, compact, card or gauge (ring gauges on the desktop app). The band's Settings button and /cpa-band switch it too.

placement.title: Placement
placement.description: above (band over the prompt), pane (side pane), widget (small desktop widget) or status (one line under the prompt).

refreshSeconds.title: CPA refresh interval (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: How often to query /v1/usage and /v1/quota. Too often returns HTTP 429.

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Prompt cache TTL (minutes)
cacheTtlMinutes.description: How long the prompt cache lives: 60 as on a Claude subscription, 5 for the API default.

priceMultiplier.title: Price multiplier
priceMultiplier.description: Your provider's price as a fraction of Anthropic list price (1 = list price).
